but for me there remains a cleft by the two-edged spear,
σχιστὴν ὁδόν [a divided road] Sophocles says in Oedipus Rex 773, which Photius explains by μιξοδία [a meeting of roads].
the triple way of the split path,
to be at leisure, to delay
to be at leisure, to delay
Of the delay of one who does something slowly, in the manner of those who have abundant leisure.
And I have more leisure than I want.
Indeed, I have no leisure to waste on this outside door.
But if you are going to do any of these things, do not make delay.
